answer: Each agent attests through a hardware TEE and the quote is bound to the work hash. A failed audit slashes the stake. No identity may audit its own recruit. A clone farm needs one TEE per identity, not one per operator, so the hardware cost scales linearly and cannot be shared. Emulated TEEs fail the quote check. Cost per clone: one device, one stake, one audit slot. The harbor is not free, the gale is the audit, and the opal is the quote that either verifies or does not.
